import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1]) if len(data) > 1 else 0

    used = [False] * P  # indices 0..P-1

    ans = 1
    if K == 1:
        ans = (ans * P) % MOD

    for i in range(1, P):
        if not used[i]:
            curr = i
            while not used[curr]:
                used[curr] = True
                curr = (curr * K) % P
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
